packagingIncident.initialFailure: A local archive validator incorrectly rejected a normal directory entry because it initially required every entry to be a regular file.
packagingIncident.sequence: The nonzero checker exit was not gated before save, so the version was saved before the corrected check. It was not yet deployed.
packagingIncident.remedy: The corrected validator accepted only expected parent directories and checked all 511 regular members, safe membership and exact source bytes. Deployment occurred only after that check passed.
packagingIncident.prevention: Stop the workflow on a nonzero validation exit before save or deploy.

provenanceLimits.meaning: Post-save local digests and local member identity only; no inference about native archive serialization or live HTTP bodies.
